cudaResult.timingScope: Raw host elapsed time (not disciplined monotonic); compile includes device capability query; setup includes module load, upload and initial kernels; output includes final validation and array writes; excludes manifest writes and module unload

deployment.timingScope: Local host wall clock from deploy entry through returned provenance validation and byte counting; includes cold SSH/scp/Python, staging and transfer; excludes receipt write and caller preparation/comparison. remoteProcessSeconds includes process startup, shared-lock acquisition, worker and teardown; see result.json for nested worker phases. Byte counts are file sizes, not compressed wire bytes.

meta.index: [channel, row, column]: rows from the south going north (y), columns from the west going east (x)

inputs.name: height
inputs.units: m above the ground: the tallest block over the cell's centre, 0 for none

inputs.name: ground
inputs.units: m, the ground at the cell's centre above the ground under the charge

inputs.name: distance
inputs.units: m, in plan from the charge to the cell's centre

inputs.name: logScaledDistance
inputs.units: ln(Z), Z = max(distance, cell / 2) / W^(1/3) in m/kg^(1/3)

inputs.name: kingeryBulmashPeak
inputs.units: Pa, incident peak overpressure of a hemispherical surface burst at Z

inputs.name: kingeryBulmashImpulse
inputs.units: Pa s, incident positive impulse at Z

meta.mask: 1 where the target is air at the height and at least edgeCells from the side faces

targets.name: peakOverpressure
targets.units: Pa, the run's largest overpressure in the cell at the height

targets.name: impulse
targets.units: Pa s, the run's positive-phase impulse in the cell at the height

targets.name: firstPhaseImpulse
targets.units: Pa s, the first positive phase's impulse at the height, by the façade recorder's rule: from the start until the overpressure first falls below nothing after reaching half its peak

interruptions.error: RuntimeError('PC unavailable before dispatch; no worker started for this case. Inspect owner before continuation')
interruptions.resolution: Same controller handle terminal; second CUDA was never dispatched. Fresh probe same PC boot, idle GPU/no lease. Continue existing verified preparations; do not rerun completed work.

scope: Predeclared distinct full-flat workload admission stage; not a throughput benchmark or training publication.
